scope: Existing Worlds2–10 themes and T44–T52; World1 snow truck remains separate.

common_rules.acquisition: World-specific reachable source/producer/route/return and fitting garage-or-dock capability before purchase. No fixed level or automatic global unlock.
common_rules.construction: Each fixture bill uses shared meaningful processed materials; all starter fuel is paid. Existing accepted quotes and owned vehicles are grandfathered.
common_rules.cargo: Same any-resource unlimited exact-count policy; dock to linked working all-resource warehouse for atomic full transfer or whole-load HOLD. No ordinary cargo exclusion for new recipe items.
common_rules.stakes: HP and actual collisions; outside ordinary cargo/tank loss; inside typed salvage. Personal driver inventory follows separate preserved-inventory recovery. No vehicle destruction immunity.
common_rules.fuel: Shared low-consumption fixture from RESOURCE_CHAINS; later-world tool grants must map to real active work. Free fuel, idle drain and fuel-gated last recovery route are forbidden.
common_rules.presentation: Readable Havenline stylization, concrete silhouettes, distinct useful locomotion/tools, visible cab access, sensible contact and stow states. Reference art is a proposal, not motion or device approval.
common_rules.working_tool: Eligible target contact only, bounded work and deterministic receipts. Safe default camp travel; hostile-defense use needs explicit contact/clearance rules. Stop tools to dock, refuel, service and exit.
common_rules.finite_project_custody: Forward authored design: relay_component is a portable serialized finite objective component. Relay Rover can haul it on deck and install it. It follows the same outside-vehicle cargo-loss rule; no protected cargo exception or free return to storage. After loss, the associated restored worksite can fabricate a paid replacement for that same objective serial from attainable ordinary shared materials. One active instance per objective serial plus a permanent one-install tombstone prevents farming or duplicate installation; loss never resets installed progress. Exact replacement inputs/amounts are pending balance and integration proof, not an implemented recipe. Source evidence establishes only finite project identity, so this new portable design must not silently reclassify any existing save. No vehicle bill uses relay_component.

current_concept_evidence.scope: Static authored concept evidence only; source-bound visual review recorded separately by root. It does not establish actual steering, clearances, service, complete cycles or all task states.

native_production_evidence.scope: Actual native normal-gameplay, overhead/clearance and meaningful additional views, full turning/route traversal, stowed/deployed tool cycles, entry/exit/dock/service/refuel, contact, blocked/resumed and save states. Full evidence planned for implementation; these are not extra mandatory concept-sheet views in this iteration.

relay_component_lifecycle.authority: Authored forward selection aligned with the selected deck-carried module and installation view; supersedes the earlier fixed-site nonportable proposal.
relay_component_lifecycle.identity: Stable objective_serial plus unique instance_generation. At most one active uninstalled instance across player/worker/vehicle/warehouse/drop/escrow custody. A serial-to-custody overlay and the corresponding counted item must change in one whole-world transaction; quantity-only aggregation cannot discard serial identity.
relay_component_lifecycle.transport_and_loss: The module is portable cargo. Normal physical transfer preserves the active instance. Destruction outside camp atomically marks the carried instance lost, removes it from vehicle custody and consumes its active-instance right; no salvage/recovery of that lost generation and no free banking. Other cargo and tank loss remain unchanged.
relay_component_lifecycle.paid_replacement: Only an uninstalled objective whose prior active instance is proven lost may admit a frozen paid replacement quote. The associated restored worksite consumes the complete ordinary-material bill and creates the next instance_generation of the same objective_serial once. Reserve the replacement right across contributions/crafting/output custody, and reject stale retries or a second active quote. Site repair, inputs and manual return must remain attainable without that missing module or the lost vehicle.
relay_component_lifecycle.replacement_bill_status: Pending authored quantities and feasibility/balance evidence. Use useful existing shared materials such as sheet_metal, steel and mechanical_parts after actual source/producer proof; these are candidates, not an implicit executable recipe. No premium payment, extra currency or relay_component input is required.
relay_component_lifecycle.installation: A successful installation atomically consumes the active instance, records the one-install tombstone and advances that objective once. Installed progress remains installed after later vehicle loss or site damage; ordinary paid site repair does not generate another component or repeat the reward.
relay_component_lifecycle.interrupted_lift: Before installation commit, ownership remains in its actual source cargo/worksite-transfer escrow; after commit, the installed objective owns the result. Restore the physical pose to that saved owner. Interruption never produces both an installed module and a cargo copy; destruction while still vehicle-owned applies ordinary outside loss.
relay_component_lifecycle.anti_farming: No sell/trade/craft-to-currency use and no repeat reward for the finite module. Replacement never issues a different objective, duplicates an installed one or increases the finite objective count. Multiple objectives have distinct serials and independent one-active/one-install proofs.
relay_component_lifecycle.save_migration: Source only declares a finite project object. Inspect existing saves first; preserve their actual portable/structural identity and custody through an explicit versioned migration or source-owned adapter. Do not silently reclassify or create replacement stock.
relay_component_lifecycle.runtime_status: Not implemented or approved by the current fuel/material component. Requires full-world custody, loss, paid replacement, worksite restoration, interrupted transfer and duplicate-install tests.
